items.title: 9.13 Resistivity aur temperature par us ka inhisar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.13 with Fig. 9.22, Table 9.2 and Examples 9.7 and 9.8 (PDF 210-212).

blocks.text: Tajrubati taur par dekha gaya hai ke taar ki resistance R us ki lambai L ke seedhe tanasub mein aur cross-sectional raqbe A ke ulat tanasub mein hai. Riyazi taur par R, L/A ke tanasub mein, ya R = rho L/A ... (9.32), jahan rho tanasub ka constant hai jise taar ke maadde ki resistivity ya specific resistance kehte hain. Resistance kisi khaas taar ki khasiyat hai, jabke resistivity us maadde ki khasiyat hai jis se taar bana. Eq. 9.32 se rho = RA/L ... (9.33).

blocks.title: Resistivity
blocks.text: Kisi maadde ki resistivity us maadde ke ek metre cube ki resistance hai. Is ki SI unit ohm-metre (ohm m) hai.

Conductance maaddon ki electrical khusoosiyat bayan karne wali ek aur miqdar hai; yeh resistance ka ulat (reciprocal) hai: G = 1/R, jahan G conductance hai. Isi tarah conductivity sigma resistivity ka ulat hai: sigma = 1/rho ... (9.34). Conductivity ki SI unit ohm^-1 m^-1, ya mho m^-1 hai. Table 9.2 dikhati hai ke chandi (silver) aur copper do behtareen conductors hain; isi liye zyada tar electric taar copper ke bante hain.

blocks.alt: -200 se 600 degree C tak temperature ke muqable mein resistivity rho ka graph. Copper ki surkh lakeer lagatar charhti hai, taqreeban seedhi: temperature barhne se resistivity barhti hai.
blocks.caption: Temperature ke muqable mein copper ki resistivity (Figure 9.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Kisi maadde ki resistivity temperature par bhi munhasir hai. Conductor ki resistance azaad electrons aur lattice ke atoms ke takraon se hai. Temperature barhne par lattice ke atoms ke larazne ka amplitude barhta hai, aur azaad electrons se un ke takrane ka imkan bhi; atoms bara nishana bante hain, yaani temperature ke saath un ka collision cross-section barhta hai. Is se takrao zyada hote hain, aur lihaza conductor ki resistance barhti hai.

Tajrubati taur par dhaati conductor ki resistance mein temperature ke saath tabdeeli 0 degrees C se oopar aur neeche temperature ki kaafi range mein taqreeban seedhi (linear) hai (Fig. 9.22, temperature ke saath copper ki resistivity). Aisi range mein fi kelvin resistance ki kasri (fractional) tabdeeli resistance ka temperature coefficient kehlati hai: alpha = (Rt - R0)/(R0 t) ... (9.35), jahan R0 aur Rt 0 degrees C aur t degrees C par resistances hain. Chunke resistivity temperature par munhasir hai, Eq. 9.32 se Rt = rho_t L/A aur R0 = rho_0 L/A ... (9.36); Eq. 9.35 mein rakhne par alpha = (rho_t - rho_0)/(rho_0 t) ... (9.37), jahan rho_0 aur rho_t 0 degrees C aur t degrees C par resistivities hain. Kuch maaddon, jaise germanium aur silicon, ki resistance temperature barhne par ghatti hai; un ke temperature coefficients manfi hain.

blocks.title: Example 9.7
blocks.text: Lohe ke taar ke siron par 1.5 V ki battery jorne se us mein 0.75 A current behta hai. Taar 5.0 m lamba hai aur cross-sectional raqba 2.5 x 10^-7 m^2 hai. Lohe ki resistivity nikalein. Hal: R = V/I = 1.5 V/0.75 A = 2.0 ohm. rho = RA/L = 2.0 ohm x 2.5 x 10^-7 m^2/5.0 m = 1.0 x 10^-7 ohm m.

blocks.title: Example 9.8
blocks.text: Platinum ke taar ki resistance 0 degrees C par 10 ohm aur 193 degrees C par 20 ohm hai. Platinum ki resistance ka temperature coefficient nikalein. Hal: R0 = 10 ohm, Rt = 20 ohm, t = 466 K - 273 K = 193 K. alpha = (Rt - R0)/(R0 t) = (20 - 10)/(10 x 193) = 1/193 K = 5.18 x 10^-3 K^-1.

Inspectors carbon fibres se bane concrete pul ki pukhtagi (reliability) aasani se jaanch sakte hain: fibres bijli guzarte hain, aur agar sensors dikhayein ke electrical resistance waqt ke saath barh rahi hai to fibres daraaron (cracks) ki wajah se alag ho rahe hain (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: 4 ohm resistance ka taar apne oopar dohra kiya jata hai; nayi resistance nikalein (MCQ 9.7). Resistance R wala copper ka taar dugni lambai tak khincha jata hai; nayi resistance nikalein (short question 9.5). Temperature barhne par conductor ki resistance kyun barhti hai (short question 9.6)?
blocks.explanation: Dohra karne se L aadhi aur A dugna hota hai, to R = rho L/A chauthai reh jati hai: 1 ohm, option (d). Dugni lambai tak khinchne se volume wahi rehta hai, to raqba aadha hota hai; L/A chaar guna hota hai aur nayi resistance 4R hai. Garam dhaat mein lattice ke atoms zyada amplitude se larazte hain, to azaad electrons un se zyada baar takrate hain aur un ka drift zyada rukta hai.

items: R = rho L/A (9.32); resistivity rho = RA/L (9.33), ohm m, maadde ki khasiyat; conductance G = 1/R; conductivity sigma = 1/rho (9.34), mho m^-1. Chandi aur copper behtareen conductors.

Garam lattice, zyada takrao, zyada R; alpha = (Rt - R0)/(R0 t) (9.35) = (rho_t - rho_0)/(rho_0 t) (9.37); carbon, germanium, silicon ka alpha manfi. Misalein: rho(loha) = 1.0 x 10^-7 ohm m; alpha(platinum) = 5.18 x 10^-3 K^-1.
